question: What will the CME October 2026 live cattle futures contract settle at on September 17, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Futures are near-martingales over an 8-session horizon, so the last settlement (212.95, Sep 4) is the anchor; I shade the median ~0.5c below it. Bearish: a five-week policy-driven downtrend (224.92 Aug 6 -> 217.22 Aug 19 -> 211.72 Aug 28 -> 212.95 Sep 4, roughly -7c per 9 sessions), the Sept 1 tariff-rate-quota proclamation (300k t lean trim over 90 days, monthly tranches), Choice cutout down $9.46 w/w, cash down ~$5 w/w, post-Labor Day demand lull, DOJ packer probe headlines. Bullish: October futures sit ~$9-10 under cash ($222-223), cash firmed to $223 late Friday, RSI lifted off 25 to 32 after the Sep 3 +4.12 short-covering rally, herd is the smallest in 75 years with record-low July placements, and the 15-year seasonal pattern bottoms in early September into October expiry. These roughly offset. Dispersion is the dominant call: this regime has produced limit-down sessions and 4c single-day swings, so I hold a ~7c SD (10-90 width ~18c) rather than the ~10-12c width a calm-regime live cattle vol would imply. Escape masses are small but real: a 190 print needs ~3 limit-down sessions in 8 (new import/policy shock), a 235 print needs a limit-up short squeeze on a policy reversal against record-tight supply. Evidence is decent on price/cash levels but thin on forward-looking analyst targets, and Barchart/CattleRange/Kalshi pages were blocked (403/429), so I lean close to the random-walk base rate.
